parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of one blade and one handle loop, typically made of stainless steel with a plastic-coated handle for comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism and provides one of the gripping loops for the user’s fingers.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot to open and close against the other blade handle set, enabling cutting action.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This part includes the second blade and handle loop, made of stainless steel with a plastic handle for grip and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the complementary half of the cutting pair and provides the second handle loop for thumb or finger placement.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw joint in coordination with the other blade handle set to perform the cutting motion.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at their pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two blades together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot point.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
